`iowriters` is a collection of reusable [`io.Writer`](https://pkg.go.dev/io#Writer) implementations for common tasks.  
All subpackages are zero‑dependency (standard library only) and follow Go’s minimalist philosophy.

## Subpackages

| Package | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [`bytesprogress`](./bytesprogress/README.md) | Periodic progress callbacks every N bytes. |
